title: 108 एंबुलेंस हड़ताल: 26 अक्टूबर से, जानें कारण

ai.summary: In Jharkhand, ambulance staff announced an indefinite strike starting October 26, 2026, after the state government agreed to delay the strike date to accommodate festivals and public emergencies.

facts.claim: In Jharkhand, ambulance staff announced an indefinite strike starting October 26, 2026
facts.quote: झारखंड में 108 एंबुलेंस कर्मचारियों की प्रस्तावित हड़ताल अब 26 अक्टूबर से शुरू होगी

facts.claim: after the state government agreed to delay the strike date to accommodate festivals and public emergencies
facts.quote: झारखंड प्रदेश एंबुलेंस कर्मचारी संघ ने दुर्गा पूजा, विजयादशमी और आम लोगों की आपातकालीन जरूरतों को ध्यान में रखते हुए हड़ताल की तारीख आगे बढ़ाने का निर्णय लिया है

ai.background_note: Ambulance staff in Jharkhand have been demanding payment for their services since July, leading to an indefinite strike that was initially scheduled for earlier in October but delayed for festivals and public emergencies.
